title: EnemyAI
description: Deterministic finite state machine for enemy behavior: idle, patrol, investigate, chase, attack, flee.

detection_range.description: Range in cells within which the entity detects hostile targets

attack_range.description: Range in cells within which the entity can attack

flee_threshold.description: Health fraction below which the entity flees

target_faction.description: Faction ID to prioritize as target

noise_detection_threshold.description: Noise level above which the entity begins investigating

alert_decay_rate.description: Amount alert_level decreases per tick when no stimulus is present
